mapper.select: SELECT FROM customs_declaration_product_view WHERE sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description_cn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sku_key LIKE CONCAT('%', normalize_customs_sku_key(#{keyword}), '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN sku = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN sku LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE WHEN id > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, sku LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM customs_declaration_product_view WHERE sku = #{sku} OR sku_key = normalize_customs_sku_key(#{sku}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN sku = #{sku} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN id > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM customs_declaration_product_view WHERE sku IN #{sku} OR sku_key IN normalize_customs_sku_key(#{sku}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN id > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, updated_at DESC

SELECT FROM customs_declaration_history WHERE
(sku = #{p.sku} AND IFNULL(product_code, '') = IFNULL(#{p.productCode}, ''))

SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.product_code, p.description_cn, p.model, p.unit, p.unit_price_usd, p.currency, p.single_weight, ROUND(IFNULL(p.single_weight, 0) * GREATEST(IFNULL(od.quantity_in_case, 1), 1) * GREATEST(IFNULL(od.box_number, 1), 1), 4) AS packing_net_weight, od.cg_box_weight AS packing_gross_weight, od.box_cbm AS packing_cbm, od.cg_box_length AS box_length, od.cg_box_width AS box_width, od.cg_box_height AS box_height, od.box_range AS box_no, p.hs_code, p.hs_description, p.origin_country, p.destination_country, p.source_location, p.exemption, COALESCE(tax.is_tax, p.is_tax) AS is_tax, p.source_type, p.source_file_name, p.source_sheet, p.source_row_no, p.updated_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, CAST(GREATEST(IFNULL(od.quantity_in_case, 1), 1) * GREATEST(IFNULL(od.box_number, 1), 1) AS SIGNED) AS quantity, CAST(GREATEST(IFNULL(od.box_number, 1), 1) AS SIGNED) AS box_count, od.overseas_order_no AS source_order_no, 'EBAY' AS declaration_source_type, CAST(od.id AS CHAR) AS source_line_id, od.sku AS raw_sku, CASE WHEN od.r_wid = 18699 THEN 'DE' WHEN od.r_wid = 18702 THEN 'UK' WHEN od.r_wid IN (18700, 18701) THEN 'US_GC' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS warehouse_bucket, COALESCE(w.name, CONCAT('r_wid=', od.r_wid), '未知仓') AS warehouse_name, CASE WHEN od.r_wid IN (18699, 18702, 18700, 18701) THEN 'MATCHED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN_WAREHOUSE' END AS match_status, od.order_total_box_volume AS order_total_cbm FROM overseas_stock_order_detail od LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.wid = od.r_wid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sku_key, MAX(is_tax) AS is_tax FROM ( SELECT normalize_customs_sku_key(item_sku) AS sku_key, is_tax FROM purchase_order WHERE item_sku IS NOT NULL AND item_sku != '' AND is_tax IS NOT NULL AND wid IN (18674, 18675, 18676) ) ebay_tax GROUP BY sku_key ) tax ON tax.sku_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = normalize_customs_sku_key(od.sku) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LEFT JOIN customs_inventory_list il ON il.id = ( SELECT i2.id FROM customs_inventory_list i2 WHERE i2.sku IS NOT NULL AND i2.sku != '' AND normalize_customs_sku_key(i2.sku) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = normalize_customs_sku_key(od.sku) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(i2.sku) LIKE 'JMH%' AND ( CASE WHEN od.r_wid = 18699 THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_de_warehouse_qty, i2.de_warehouse_qty, 0) WHEN od.r_wid = 18702 THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_uk_warehouse_qty, i2.uk_warehouse_qty, 0) WHEN od.r_wid IN (18700, 18701) THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_us_warehouse_qty, i2.us_warehouse_qty, 0) ELSE COALESCE(i2.auto_remaining_stock, i2.remaining_stock, 0) END - COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(l.quantity) FROM customs_declaration_generate_log l WHERE l.standard_sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = i2.sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND IFNULL(l.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = IFNULL(i2.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND l.warehouse_bucket COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = (CASE WHEN od.r_wid = 18699 THEN 'DE' WHEN od.r_wid = 18702 THEN 'UK' WHEN od.r_wid IN (18700, 18701) THEN 'US_GC' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ), 0) ) > 0 THEN 0 WHEN UPPER(i2.sku) NOT LIKE 'JMH%' AND ( CASE WHEN od.r_wid = 18699 THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_de_warehouse_qty, i2.de_warehouse_qty, 0) WHEN od.r_wid = 18702 THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_uk_warehouse_qty, i2.uk_warehouse_qty, 0) WHEN od.r_wid IN (18700, 18701) THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_us_warehouse_qty, i2.us_warehouse_qty, 0) ELSE COALESCE(i2.auto_remaining_stock, i2.remaining_stock, 0) END - COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(l.quantity) FROM customs_declaration_generate_log l WHERE l.standard_sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = i2.sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND IFNULL(l.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = IFNULL(i2.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND l.warehouse_bucket COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = (CASE WHEN od.r_wid = 18699 THEN 'DE' WHEN od.r_wid = 18702 THEN 'UK' WHEN od.r_wid IN (18700, 18701) THEN 'US_GC' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ), 0) ) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(i2.sku) LIKE 'JMH%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, i2.id LIMIT 1 ) INNER JOIN customs_declaration_product_view p ON ((il.sku IS NOT NULL AND p.sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = il.sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND IFNULL(p.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = IFNULL(il.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) OR (il.sku IS NULL AND p.sku_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = normalize_customs_sku_key(od.sku) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)) WHERE od.overseas_order_no IN #{order} ORDER BY FIELD(od.overseas_order_no, #{order} ), od.id

SELECT DISTINCT od.sku FROM overseas_stock_order_detail od LEFT JOIN customs_inventory_list il ON il.id = ( SELECT i2.id FROM customs_inventory_list i2 WHERE i2.sku IS NOT NULL AND i2.sku != '' AND normalize_customs_sku_key(i2.sku) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = normalize_customs_sku_key(od.sku) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(i2.sku) LIKE 'JMH%' AND ( CASE WHEN od.r_wid = 18699 THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_de_warehouse_qty, i2.de_warehouse_qty, 0) WHEN od.r_wid = 18702 THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_uk_warehouse_qty, i2.uk_warehouse_qty, 0) WHEN od.r_wid IN (18700, 18701) THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_us_warehouse_qty, i2.us_warehouse_qty, 0) ELSE COALESCE(i2.auto_remaining_stock, i2.remaining_stock, 0) END - COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(l.quantity) FROM customs_declaration_generate_log l WHERE l.standard_sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = i2.sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND IFNULL(l.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = IFNULL(i2.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND l.warehouse_bucket COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = (CASE WHEN od.r_wid = 18699 THEN 'DE' WHEN od.r_wid = 18702 THEN 'UK' WHEN od.r_wid IN (18700, 18701) THEN 'US_GC' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ), 0) ) > 0 THEN 0 WHEN UPPER(i2.sku) NOT LIKE 'JMH%' AND ( CASE WHEN od.r_wid = 18699 THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_de_warehouse_qty, i2.de_warehouse_qty, 0) WHEN od.r_wid = 18702 THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_uk_warehouse_qty, i2.uk_warehouse_qty, 0) WHEN od.r_wid IN (18700, 18701) THEN COALESCE(i2.auto_us_warehouse_qty, i2.us_warehouse_qty, 0) ELSE COALESCE(i2.auto_remaining_stock, i2.remaining_stock, 0) END - COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(l.quantity) FROM customs_declaration_generate_log l WHERE l.standard_sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = i2.sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND IFNULL(l.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = IFNULL(i2.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND l.warehouse_bucket COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = (CASE WHEN od.r_wid = 18699 THEN 'DE' WHEN od.r_wid = 18702 THEN 'UK' WHEN od.r_wid IN (18700, 18701) THEN 'US_GC' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ), 0) ) > 0 THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(i2.sku) LIKE 'JMH%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, i2.id LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN customs_declaration_product_view p ON ((il.sku IS NOT NULL AND p.sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = il.sku COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND IFNULL(p.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = IFNULL(il.product_code, '') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) OR (il.sku IS NULL AND p.sku_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = normalize_customs_sku_key(od.sku) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)) WHERE od.overseas_order_no IN #{order} AND od.sku IS NOT NULL AND od.sku != '' AND p.sku IS NULL ORDER BY od.sku

SELECT DISTINCT od.sku FROM overseas_stock_order_detail od LEFT JOIN ( SELECT match_key FROM ( SELECT normalize_customs_sku_key(sku) AS match_key, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY normalize_customs_sku_key(sku) ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM customs_inventory_list WHERE sku IS NOT NULL AND sku != '' ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) il ON normalize_customs_sku_key(od.sku) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = il.match_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE od.overseas_order_no IN #{order} AND od.sku IS NOT NULL AND od.sku != '' AND il.match_key IS NULL ORDER BY od.sku

SELECT b.shipment_id AS shipmentId, b.sku AS sku, SUM(IF(b.quantity_in_case IS NOT NULL AND b.quantity_in_case REGEXP '^[0-9.]+$', CAST(b.quantity_in_case AS DECIMAL(12,4)), 1) * GREATEST(IFNULL(b.box_num, 1), 1)) AS totalQuantity, MAX(GREATEST(IFNULL(b.box_num, 1), 1)) AS totalBoxCount, MAX(tax.is_tax) AS isTax FROM amz_fba_shipment_box b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT shipment_id, sku_key, is_tax FROM ( SELECT base.shipment_id, base.sku_key, po.is_tax, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY base.shipment_id, base.sku_key ORDER BY CASE WHEN po.order_time IS NOT NULL AND ref.gmt_create IS NOT NULL AND po.order_time <= ref.gmt_create THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN po.order_time IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, po.order_time, COALESCE(ref.gmt_create, NOW()))), po.order_time DESC, po.create_time DESC, po.id DESC ) AS rn FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT shipment_id, normalize_customs_sku_key(sku) AS sku_key FROM amz_fba_shipment_box WHERE shipment_id IN #{shipment} AND sku IS NOT NULL AND sku != '' ) base LEFT JOIN ( SELECT shipment_id, MAX(gmt_create) AS gmt_create FROM amz_fba_shipment WHERE shipment_id IN #{shipment} GROUP BY shipment_id ) ref ON ref.shipment_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = base.shipment_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci INNER JOIN purchase_order po ON normalize_customs_sku_key(po.item_sku) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = base.sku_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND po.item_sku IS NOT NULL AND po.item_sku != '' AND po.is_tax IS NOT NULL AND po.wid IN (18677, 18678, 18679, 18680, 19561) ) ranked_tax WHERE rn = 1 ) tax ON tax.shipment_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = b.shipment_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND tax.sku_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = normalize_customs_sku_key(b.sku) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE b.shipment_id IN #{shipment} GROUP BY b.shipment_id, b.sku ORDER BY FIELD(b.shipment_id, #{shipment} ), b.sku
